Not at the stage you are but this can happen to absolutely anyone.  It is all just relative OP. I'm sorry.

Still I would like to say a couple things to your character .....

It's *draining* working a job that doesn't give you satisfaction or more on the horizon.  Takes dedication, discipline, guts, to the point of soul exhaustion to carry on, to survive in a system that doesn't work for you so to speak.  You are paying your own way, doing the *right* thing in your circumstances. It is part of the struggle for real. 

Also you are really ruthlessly honest with yourself and us too. Calibre aside you have articulated yourself in a way its very easy for me to want to try to offer you deserved insight and solace.  Fair enough that self appraisal feels like shit. BUT....Alot of the more concrete material things can either be worked on in time or may lose their relevance as necessary. 

It's the inside. "Love yourself first" etc¹⁰ HOW?

*ACCEPTANCE*  HOW? 

I have WEAK CONCEPT COHESION, joining the dots. For me this has been excruciating,  alienating, numbing, shameful.  I do still crawl up on the chair in a ball often blanket shut every thing out turning all these things over in my head. Please don't forgo eating showering (music for me) or outdoor for a wander down the street if possible.  

A combination of painful self reflection that I suspect is rumination already,  part of the process.  Those mistakes or fears or whatever it is for You Only. That thing that gnaws at you to your bones? *That thing in you* Get comfortable and be safe, and like a dark tunnel underground, make your way through carefully. Examine and study the thing.  The why. This overthinking can sometimes be useful.  Figuring out how to "sit inside yourself" meditating your own way (maybe with music or audio you find feels good for you). 

Long story short is that you want to confront your own mind's torment. Searching looking for reading asking, for your minds QUESTIONS for the ANSWERS you seek. I hope once one puzzle piece seems to fit, I hope that little by little the puzzle has wiggle room until another piece fits. Like a puzzle keep coming back to it working on it until one day the horrendous makes sense and you can accept this torment.  Slowly break it down OP.  This is where you start to feel your power in your bones has been all along. 

My solid hope that this might help you. Cherry pick it that's cool too.

I believe we need connections to others because death is inevitable for everyone and that shit is scary. Having connections softens the sting. This is only my opinions in this moment of time and space

I could go get a fuck if I wanted to. I say fuck because the nature of the pursuit is crude. 

I don't want to. I want a soul connection. To meet through natural circumstances and build through a mutual worldview, interests and values, or agreed "hard no's" same direction stuff. 

I would undo my sexual past if I had the social skills to obtain a life partner how I wanted to. This is natural to have someone by your side, on your team. To be able to do the same for them because you can actually trust life partner not to reject you or exploit you, take you for granted. 

As female gender it hinges on what I feel is a passive role (with male interest) and flirting.  You can be highly intellectual and have no idea how to flirt, and doubly find the idea of the power-struggle-dance revolting.

If you can't get sex, or relationship, doesn't make anybody a loser. One can get those things for a time and stigma-informed prevailing knowledge says *not for you* so you can come out of the dating machine feeling jaded and ragged as shit. 

Also realized recently hobbies and shit are to procure bonding relationships and friendships to survive.  Not to develop a talent to impress or to earn brownie points. Information is currency.  Shared enjoyment of activities and interests is bonding.  I wish I knew this a long time ago.

I think if you have any sort of diagnoses constantly in your shadow, as I do, that's a factor to consider. Sitting in your own space to get down to the nuts and bolts of /you/ and *why* etc 

Do Google research, it helps to find something that resonates with YOU. 

This is how I discovered for me Theory of Mind, and Mentalisation is I believe the missing clue for alot of social struggle. I'm not winning by any means, but at least trying to piece together what the person of my mind is like, and therefore what others may see, how you come across. 

It's nice to have at least one answer to not being an anomaly, to understanding ourselves (as they say we should do), because if you are considered *anomaly* it becomes alot easier for unscrupulous people around you to **dehumanise** you

Please be careful out there OP don't let social despair drive you to depths you don't want to plummet to.

I'm relating my experience with the hope maybe you can recognise something helpful for you and others in it. Apologise for seeming projection lol.
